title: Prompt Vault — Feature Reference
purpose: Describes each major feature, how it works, and which files are involved.

prompt_library.description: Grid of prompt cards with search, filter by tag/category/collection/starred, and full CRUD
prompt_library.notes: Search is client-side filtered via query param. Tags are stored as a text array. Starred is a boolean toggle.

prompt_editor.description: Full editor for a single prompt: title, tags, category, notes, markdown body with split-pane preview
prompt_editor.notes: Markdown editor is split-pane: write on left, rendered preview on right.

collections.description: Folder-like groups for organizing prompts. Shown in sidebar. Prompts can be dragged into collections.
collections.drag_and_drop: window.__setDraggingPromptId is a global bridge between prompt-card.tsx and the collections sidebar in layout.tsx to avoid prop-drilling
collections.notes: promptCount on Collection is denormalized and updated when prompts are added/removed.

vault_folder_watcher.description: Monitors a local folder and automatically imports new/changed .md files as prompts
constraints: Only works in Chrome and Edge browsers
Does not work in Replit preview pane
Does not work in Firefox or Safari
User must re-grant permission if the handle is revoked
vault_folder_watcher.polling: Checks the directory on an interval and imports files not yet in the DB

markdown_import.description: Import one or more .md files via drag-drop or file picker into the prompt library
markdown_import.notes: Frontmatter fields title, tags, category are parsed and mapped to the prompt schema.

ai_assistant.description: Multi-turn AI chat session using the configured provider and model
ai_assistant.persistence: Session-only — chat history is NOT stored in the database
ai_assistant.configuration: Provider, model, and API keys stored in localStorage via Settings page

mcp_manager.description: Add and manage MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool servers that extend the AI assistant

settings.description: Configure AI provider, model selection, and API keys
settings.storage: localStorage only — not persisted to DB
settings.notes: Keys are stored client-side. For production use, consider moving to server-side env vars.
